test_title: PYST 23: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'MAIN' is written as 'OHBL' and 'MAIL' is written as 'MHBL'. How will 'MANY’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'MAIN' is written as 'OHBL'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f02f8a3683415db4a821e6805b1bf91b498c3f92fd0eae49e4d8365ed3494ca.png] 

'MAIL' is written as 'MHBL'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d74c8ddb83049a3dabe0d42b5eea8f4b24267d10052bb7f9954dd55db9f7af70.png] 

Similarly, '**MANY**’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10148e3ad666e1d54d96d5364d343992fc9b0bd090bbe89b308f50d4d590dcdb.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"ZMBL".**
